items.title: Think It’s Cool to Wear Fancy Sneakers to Work? You Might Be Old.
items.content: After years of office casual, young people are embracing loafers, derbies and oxfords.

items.title: Medicare Advantage’s Perks Are Getting Scrutiny
items.content: Officials said no to health plans that wanted to expand extra benefits to cover medical marijuana, streaming services and shopping clubs. More changes are coming in 2027.

items.title: How an N.F.L.-Backed Plan to Revitalize Canton, Ohio, Faltered
items.content: The “Hall of Fame Village” was pitched in 2014 as a boon to the city. But hundreds of millions were spent, the N.F.L. backed out, and the project is unfinished.

items.title: Can Netflix Save a Summer Slump With a Stunt on Sunset Boulevard?
items.content: The streaming giant, still looking for this year’s blockbuster, paid an actor to spend three days inside a billboard in Los Angeles to promote an upcoming film.
